rarity_system.render_rule: Render the rarity text followed by a small diamond icon. Format: 'RARE ◆'. All rarities use diamond shape, only fill color varies. No brackets.

cost_indicator.render_rule: For RARE and GLORIOUS cards only, display the activation cost below the rarity diamond using a plus symbol and card icons.

stat_pips.filled_style: solid navy fill with gold outline

content.GLOSS: Name; the eldest son of Noah, father of the blessed line
content.ART_PROMPT: A dark goat-hair dwelling on a ridge at night, its doorway flap drawn back and lit from within, a striped woven mantle folded on the threshold, no people, luminous cinematic oil painting with impressionistic brushwork, saturated full colour, a strong symbolic subject, no engraving or line art, night under a lantern, a warm amber pool of light in deep indigo dark
content.ABILITY_TEXT: Choose another player. Each of you reveals one card from your hand; if your revealed card has the higher COMPLEXITY, add up to two cards from Sheol to your hand.
content.OT_VERSE_SNIPPET: Blessed be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant
content.NT_VERSE_SNIPPET: which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe
content.OT_VERSE_LINE: Genesis 9:26 — “Blessed be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant”
content.NT_VERSE_LINE: Luke 3:36 — “which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe”
TRIVIA_BULLETS: Genesis 9:26 blesses the LORD God of Shem rather than Shem himself - the only blessing in the chapter aimed past the man to his God.
Shem is introduced in Genesis 10:21 as the father of all the children of Eber, four generations before Eber is born in the text.
The builders at Babel say let us make us a name - shem - two chapters after a man named Shem has been given one.

model_prompt: Generate a premium vertical trading card. Output ONLY the card; no surrounding text or watermarks. NEVER use brackets [ ]. RARITY: Print rarity text then a diamond icon (e.g. 'RARE ◆'). Diamond color: white=COMMON, green=UNCOMMON, gold=RARE, orange=GLORIOUS. All use same diamond shape. COST INDICATOR: Below rarity for RARE show '+🂠' (plus and one card), for GLORIOUS show '+🂠🂠' (plus and two cards). No cost indicator for COMMON/UNCOMMON. STAT PIPS: Use navy circles only, not diamonds. Render: header, stats, ability, OT verse, NT verse, Greek/Heb strip, trivia. Greek/Hebrew must be legible (Hebrew right-to-left).
